title: %depreciation — straight-line depreciation per period
purpose: Compute the constant per-period depreciation: (cost − salvage) / life.
input:
cost = #10000
salvage = #2000
life = ##5
lowCost = #2000
highSalvage = #10000
zero = ##0
notes: An asset costing 10000 with 2000 salvage over a 5-year life depreciates 1600 per year.
A life <= 0, or a salvage greater than cost, yields ~ (null).

avoid.why: when salvage exceeds cost the result is ~ (null), not a negative depreciation
